result:
I've finished all four items of T-DG6-BE-Z12B. The inventory test now pins zero `open` and zero `PENDING` rows. Every required check exits 0 on the final tree, and the DG5 historical validator passed at the start and at the end. Changes are uncommitted for you to integrate. I ran from 10:44:31Z to 11:56:03Z, about 72 minutes.

**What changed**
1. **Work items and My Work (D-222 (1)).** A work item is restricted when its subject, or the record its stored link names, is a sensitive record the reader isn't admitted to. This now applies to the assignee too. A restricted item returns `subjectId`/`recordId` null, links to the transformation home, and carries `includesRestrictedRecords: true`.
   - The assignee can still complete it; the completion response is redacted as well. Before, it wasn't redacted at all.
   - The My Work page cursor no longer carries the hidden record's id.
   - I found and fixed one more leak: the workspace header's "next actions" showed the same items with no redaction at all.
   - Contract and zod mirrors: `WorkItem.subjectId` and `MyWorkItem.recordId` are now `NullableUuid`.
   - Web: My Work rows (`HomeRegions.tsx`, `MyWorkSections.tsx`) no longer key on `recordId`, and restricted rows show the restricted label in en and ar. I also changed the row keys in `WorkspaceHeader.tsx`, which isn't named in the assignment. It renders the same items, and two restricted rows would have collided.
2. **Automation rule conditions (D-222 (2)).** A condition value that names a hidden record reads back as the marker `"[restricted]"` in its place, with the flag set. The rule summary says "a restricted record" / "سجل مقيد". The rule's own summary leaked the id too and is fixed. Saving the marker back in the same condition and position keeps the stored value unchanged. The rule screen shows the restricted label on that condition.
3. **The six PENDING rows.** Each now has a test that seeds its own data. Their redaction code was already merged by BE-Z12, so for the "before" run I temporarily disabled each redaction call. All five tests fail that way and pass with it restored; one test covers both procedure-instance rows.
4. **Inventory.** The open and PENDING lists are both empty. The inventory test reports `redacted=48`.

**Checks**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `pnpm -r typecheck`, `pnpm -r build`, `pnpm lint`, prettier, `pnpm openapi:lint` | all exit 0 |
| `pnpm test`, locale unset and `C.UTF-8` | each: 2899 unit-node, 2082 unit-web, 259 no-codegen passed (+2 skipped that were already there) |
| Integration, in `with-pg.sh` | 79 files / 700 tests; 28 QA files / 279 tests; 45 files / 455 tests re-run on the final tree |
| e2e a22 and a13, real stack, en and ar | 4 passed |

The integration runs included the worker job, failure-queue, automation-recovery, operations and operational-exception files, and the BE-Z6 race test.

Two runs failed along the way; both are fixed and logged:
- **First build:** a type error in one of my new web tests.
- **First two `pnpm test` runs:** the architecture test flagged four `x[i]` index accesses in my code. I changed them to `.at(i)`, which doesn't change behaviour.

The first two integration runs (700 and 279 tests) ran just before that last edit. The final 455-test re-run covers the files those edits touch.

**Decisions for you**
- **Confirm the type change:** `WorkItem.subjectId` and `MyWorkItem.recordId` are now nullable. D-222 implies this; the web app was updated in the same change.
- **Optional:** a rule author who types a uuid that turns out to be a hidden record's id will see the marker on read, which tells them it's restricted. BE-Z12 accepted the same trade-off for procedure subjects. Refusing such a write would mean a new 422 on a free-text field, so I didn't add one.
- One finding: no code that writes `revision_proposal.validation_report` ever puts a record id in it. I kept the row as `redacted` and tested it with a seeded report.

There are no migrations, no new dependencies, and no change to my pending-operations list. No existing en/ar text became untrue. The handback also carries ADR-0051 text for the architect.

The handback is `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG6/T-DG6-BE-Z12B-backend-workflow-engineer.md`; the before/after logs are in `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG6/T-DG6-BE-Z12B-evidence/`.
